name: SYNTHETIC-GRADIENT-WRITER-1
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG SYNTHETIC-GRADIENT-WRITER-1 (L69765) as sealed by AMENDMENT -ARENA (L70126) and AMENDMENT -SEAL; the prose governs. Qualification only; NO seed-27 birth is authorized by the seal (separate Artin GO).

arena.frozen: emb.weight + blocks 0..3 (29 tensors) at W_0, freeze_lower(model, 4), re-verified bit-identical at the end of every birth
arena.head_norm: true CE gradient with x_8 detached (the sealed DFA / frontier treatment)
arena.model_recipe: stock: AdamW lr 3e-4 wd 0.01 clip 1.0 OneCycle pct_start 0.03, 15,420 steps, BS 32, pinned stock stream, 17 snapshots, mps fp32

credit_law.hat_delta: hat_delta_l = s_l * G_phi_l(stopgrad(x_{l+1}), stopgrad(e_t)) at eligible label positions (labels != -100) only; delta^BP is exactly zero at ineligible (pad) positions and no credit is applied there; block l receives J_f_l^T hat_delta_l only (surrogate <hat_delta.detach(), x_{l+1}>, block input detached)
credit_law.constants_source: logs/sgaudit0/audit.json normalization_constants.arena_frozen_4_7 (OBSERVATION SG-PREDICTOR-AUDIT-0 L70301); sha256 recorded in every receipt
credit_law.teacher: parameter-detached functional_call pass at W_t (activation graph only); delta^BP_l = dL/dx_{l+1}; targets used only as predictor regression targets
fold_a_step_order: teacher pass at W_t, delta^BP_t cached
predictor regression against cached delta^BP_t backward
clip model and predictor gradients separately (1.0 each)
credit_law.fold_b_loss: L_l = mean over eligible label positions (labels != -100) and hidden dimensions of (G_l - delta^BP_l / s_l)^2; L_phi = mean_l L_l

predictor_families.linear: G = hA + eB + C, output zero-init, 163,200 params per block
predictor_families.mlp256: one ReLU hidden layer width 256, output zero-init, 207,488 params per block

credit_law.predictor_optimizer: AdamW(PLR, wd 0), OneCycle of the stock shape, clip 1.0 separately; predictor init seed 1000 + birth seed
credit_law.first_step_property: zero-output predictors: SG-block gradients exactly zero at step 0; block motion is AdamW decoupled weight decay only (not credit)
credit_law.baseline_logged: the zero-predictor baseline of the FOLD B reduction (G = 0) is logged beside pred_mse at every logged step (sg_log baseline_mse, per block too)

integrity.law: structural: the true loss graph contains activations only (parameters enter as detached constants), so true gradients cannot reach any block parameter by construction; true gradients update only the predictors
integrity.smoke: scratch/sg_integrity_smoke.py checks a..k on the frozenbb1_smoke finals, (arena, full) x (linear, mlp256); development receipts logs/sgwriter1/integrity_smoke_seal.jsonl (pre-fold) and logs/sgwriter1/integrity_smoke_<commit>.jsonl (per commit, refuse-if-exists, '-dirty' suffix on a dirty tree); the driver reruns it FIRST on the launch commit (logs/sgwriter1/integrity_smoke_<launch commit>.jsonl + logs/sgwriter1/integrity_smoke_launch.log, force-added at booking) and aborts with no birth on any failure
checks: a teacher logits == writer logits (tol 1e-5, measured 0.0)
b teacher loss reaches no parameter
c predictor loss reaches phi only
d block grads bit-identical to constants-only surrogate
e head/norm grads bit-identical to true CE; frozen grads none
f applied hat_delta predates the predictor step
g skipping the predictor step leaves block grads bit-identical
h FOLD A: cached target == pre-step teacher target bit-exactly, != post-step target
j zero-output endpoint: zero SG-block gradients, block motion = decoupled weight decay, frozen bit-identical

i forced-delta^BP endpoint reproduces the frozen-top BP gradients and one AdamW step (tol grad rel 1e-5, param 1e-6; measured 0.0 / 0.0) -- ARENA cases only (2 of 4); full-stack has no frozen-top reference and records i_note
k eligibility: delta^BP exactly zero at every ineligible (pad) position and so is the applied credit; credit nonzero at eligible positions; baseline MSE recorded

ladder.control: MODE=zero K_BP=4 (BP-top-over-frozen), born and gated first; c = its gate
ladder.adequate_control: finite and c >= 24; else NOT-RESOLVABLE-CONTROL, no SG cell adjudicated
ladder.stopping: FIRST FUNCTION-MATCH stops the ladder and freezes the recipe (family, PLR, constants, every writer-law detail); later cells are not born
ladder.no_match: ACCESSIBILITY-ONLY (each finite cell's gate booked; STABLE iff finite and g > 0; FLOOR g >= 24 descriptive); no discovery; if no cell finished finite: LADDER-UNSTABLE
ladder.unstable_cell: non-finite loss books the cell UNSTABLE (no final; the freeze law is still verified and recorded; the ladder continues to the next cell)
ladder.alignment: cos(hat_delta_l, delta^BP_l) per block, logged every 200 steps and at snapshots: descriptive only, never a qualification bar

bars.name: FUNCTION-MATCH
bars.note: first matching cell in the frozen order

interpretation: a FUNCTION-MATCH qualifies the SG credit law and the selected predictor recipe on blocks 4..7 over a frozen random backbone; it does NOT qualify or establish full-stack SG; full-stack seed-2 SG remains the discovery / accessibility test with no tuning from its outcome

registered_prior.pred_mse_matched_cell: at step 1028 the logged pred_mse is below 0.5 x the logged baseline_mse of the SAME log row (both computed at the pre-step W of step 1028 under the FOLD B reduction); p 0.6
registered_prior.alignment_matched_cell_final: cos(hat_delta, delta^BP) above 0.3 on every SG block at the final (p 0.6; descriptive, never a bar)

storage_note: 5 x 18 model files x 75.7 MB = 6.81 GB + predictor files (4 SG cells x 18 x 2.6 to 3.3 MB = 0.21 GB) = 7.0 GB decimal; the control has no predictors
receipts_by_pattern: logs/sgwriter1/integrity_smoke_<launch commit>.jsonl (named by the launch commit; force-added at booking)
